answer: Re-attestations are stored in island and relic lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the shale graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 4 dollars and 4 days per identity, which turns a 550 account sybil into a 3 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
